title: Audio processing: noise, speaker separation and segmentation

videos.script: Most of the work on audio happens before a model hears a single word. {{title}} A recording has noise in it. It has silence between the words. And it has more than one person talking. {{call}} You will take a support call at Marginalia, and ruin it on purpose. A hum, and a hiss loud enough to cover the voices. {{noisy}} Then you will try three ways to clean it, and let Whisper tell you which one helped. {{clean}} The answer is not the one you would guess. The tool that cleans best for the ear is not the best for the transcriber. {{surprise}} Then two more models. One finds where people are speaking. One works out who is speaking when. {{who}} The lab knows who really spoke, second by second, because the call was read from a script. So every claim gets a number. {{end}}
